Name: Fish Preview and Tracker
Author: APPLEIOHHJk
Description:
[size=5][b]🐟 Fish Preview and Tracker[/b][/size]
The ultimate fishing companion for Stardew Valley 1.6! This mod helps you identify fish before you catch them and tracks their exact locations on the world map.

[size=4][b]✨ Features:[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Fish Preview:[/b] Displays the fish image next to the fishing minigame bar.[/*]
[*][b]Map Tracker:[/b] Hover over any fish in your Collections tab and press [b]M[/b] (configurable) to instantly see where to catch it on the world map![/*]
[*][b]Detailed Info Box:[/b] Shows the target fish, locations, seasons, and time requirements directly on the map.[/*]
[*][b]Ginger Island Support:[/b] Fully supports Ginger Island locations (Island South, West, North, etc.).[/*]
[*][b]GMCM Support:[/b] Fully customizable via [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b]. You can change keybinds, toggle features, adjust image scales, and even hide uncaught fish.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]⚙️ Requirements:[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]SMAPI[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu (Optional, but highly recommended for settings)[/*]
[/list]📌 [b]Things to Know:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]SVE:[/b] Does not support Stardew Valley Expanded (Errors might occur).[/*]
[*][b]Standard World:[/b] Right now, it only supports the standard Stardew Valley world.[/*]
[*][b]Bugs:[/b] I apologize if there are any errors with the mod. Please let me know![/*]
[/list]

Manifest.Name: Fish Preview
Manifest.Description: Shows the fish image before the fishing minigame starts.
Manifest.Author: APP
